records.title: Generalization of Diffusion Models Arises with a Balanced Representation Space
records.reason: Primary abstract is about memorization/generalization in diffusion generative models and representation steering; it presents no LLM inference or serving method, despite the input citation route.

records.title: Real-space machine learning of correlation density functionals
records.reason: Publisher article develops real-space ML correlation density functionals for quantum chemistry using Møller–Plesset/DFT energy densities; its computational efficiency and data-efficiency claims concern chemical simulation/training, not LLM inference or the linked torch.compile serving/compiler lineage.

records.title: A Hybrid Neural Network Transformer for Detecting and Classifying Destructive Content in Digital Space
records.reason: Publisher full text concerns cyberbullying/destructive-content classification with a hybrid BiLSTM/RoBERTa/attention/KAN architecture. It is an application classifier, not a general LLM inference optimization; reported added model components do not establish serving improvements.

records.title: Mantis: A Versatile Vision-Language-Action Model with Disentangled Visual Foresight
records.reason: Primary abstract concerns VLA visual-future prediction and robot manipulation training; no LLM inference-system optimization is proposed.

records.title: REVISOR: Beyond Textual Reflection, Towards Multimodal Introspective Reasoning in Long-Form Video Understanding
